subject: Site Engineer application (SEEK 95871692)

letter.company_line: Cono Services is a civil contractor specialising in bulk excavation, earthworks, demolition and complex civil works alongside Tier 1 contractors.
letter.subject: Bulk Excavation & Civil Site Engineer, Sydney (SEEK 95871692)
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Bulk Excavation and Civil Site Engineer role. Your advert welcomes graduate level applicants and centres on reading drawings and specifications on site, Inspection and Test Plans, quality records and daily progress against the program, which is the site work I want to build on.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. In that course I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I reviewed drawings and checked work against project requirements, carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, and worked with subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

I have about ten months of site experience rather than the one to four years you mention, and I have not used survey instruments on a job, so set out would be something I learn from your team. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, and am open to discussing relocation to Sydney.
My resume is attached, and I would welcome the chance to talk about the role.

checklist: Confirm Marc is willing to relocate to Sydney for this role
Search Gmail in:anywhere for Cono Services before applying (Gmail was not reachable on this tick)

Open SEEK job 95871692 (closes 13 Dec 2026) and apply; answer the four SEEK questions honestly (485 full working rights; salary and notice for Marc to decide; site engineer experience less than 1 year)
Attach the resume and cover letter from this folder

screening_answers.a: Temporary graduate visa (Subclass 485) with full working rights until December 2027
Marc to answer (no salary figure on record)
